content.short: STEPN is the world’s first move-to-earn game requiring users to walk or run in NFT sneakers.
content.description: STEPN is a move-to-earn game that launched in late 2021 by FindSatoshi Lab. Built on Solana, it emphasizes low gas fees and a reduced carbon footprint. Players can try the core mechanics for free, but to start earning native tokens GST and GMT, they must purchase NFT sneakers whose varying stats influence their value. The more you move, the more you earn. Sneakers, and other gear, can be traded on NFT marketplaces as you progress.
content.meta: STEPN is the world’s first move-to-earn game using NFT sneakers for walking or running. Discover STEPN and other Decentralized Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
